title: OpenAITTSProxy
description: supabase/functions/openai-tts-proxy/index.ts. Generates the in-app voice-preview clip (Settings > voice picker). Deliberately narrow: the client sends only {voice}; the model (gpt-4o-mini-tts) and the spoken phrase are fixed server-side (PREVIEW_PHRASE = "Hi, I'm Mira, your AI companion. How can I help you today?") so every voice speaks the same line and the endpoint can't be abused as a general-purpose TTS sink. On success, response Content-Type is audio/mpeg (raw MP3 bytes), not JSON — model this as a binary response, not a JSON object.

voice.title: OpenAITTSProxyVoice

OpenAITTSProxySuccessResponse.title: OpenAITTSProxySuccessResponse
OpenAITTSProxySuccessResponse.description: The actual HTTP response is a raw audio/mpeg byte stream, not JSON — this schema entry exists only to document that binary contract for a codegen target that needs an explicit type (most HTTP client generators treat this endpoint as returning a byte array / Data / Stream, not a decoded model type).
